in_marathi.name: Ved
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ved हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The root word 'ved' in Sanskrit means knowledge, and it is derived from the verb 'vid', meaning 'to know'. It is the source of the term 'Vedas', which are the oldest texts in the Hindu tradition.

in_bengali.name: Ved
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ved একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The root word 'ved' in Sanskrit means knowledge, and it is derived from the verb 'vid', meaning 'to know'. It is the source of the term 'Vedas', which are the oldest texts in the Hindu tradition.
